_comment: Technology/CVE-specific chains. Each grounds a specific, real, patched-for-years CVE (CVSS/description verified against NVD) rather than the generic 'web AppSec 101' chains in bridges.json. Entry: a fingerprinting action from web_target_identified fans out into per-technology recon states; each then has one exploit action reaching a {tech}_{cve}_confirmed state, bridged into the same low_priv_shell_obtained capability state used by the generic classes. Log4Shell skips the fingerprint step -- blind JNDI injection is tried broadly in practice, not gated behind first confirming Log4j is in use.

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Spring MVC/WebFlux application (Spring Boot error pages, Whitelabel Error Page, or actuator endpoints).

detection_signals.description: Default Spring Boot error response format or reachable /actuator endpoints.
examples: response body contains "Whitelabel Error Page"
GET /actuator/env returns 200 with environment properties

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as Atlassian Confluence Server/Data Center.

detection_signals.description: Confluence-specific login page branding, /server-info.action, or X-Confluence-* headers.
examples: response headers include "X-Confluence-Request-Time"
/server-info.action discloses the Confluence version

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a self-hosted GitLab instance.

detection_signals.description: GitLab-specific sign-in page branding or /help page disclosing version.
examples: /help page footer discloses the GitLab version string

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Laravel application running with debug mode (Ignition error page) enabled.

detection_signals.description: Triggering an application error returns the Ignition debug page instead of a generic error.
examples: forcing a 500 error returns a page with "Ignition" branding and a stack trace with local file paths

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as an Apache Struts 2 application (file upload / .action endpoints).

detection_signals.description: URLs use the .action extension, or a Struts-specific error page/stack trace is triggerable.
examples: endpoint paths end in .action
malformed request triggers a Struts-branded exception page

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) / Gateway appliance.

detection_signals.description: Citrix-branded login portal at the default management path.
examples: /vpn/index.html serves the Citrix Gateway login page

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Microsoft Exchange Server (OWA/ECP reachable).

detection_signals.description: OWA or ECP login portal reachable at the default paths.
examples: /owa/ serves the Outlook Web App login page
/ecp/ serves the Exchange admin center login page

states.description: Spring4Shell-style exploitation was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Payload rejected or had no effect; likely patched, wrong JDK version, or not a WAR/Tomcat deployment.

states.description: The Confluence OGNL injection exploit was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Injected OGNL expression was not evaluated; version is likely patched.

states.description: The GitLab ExifTool RCE exploit was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Crafted image processed without triggering an OOB callback; version is likely patched.

states.description: The Laravel Ignition RCE exploit was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Debug mode is disabled or Ignition is patched -- no Ignition error page reachable.

states.description: The Struts Jakarta Multipart RCE exploit was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: OGNL payload in Content-Type header had no effect; version is likely patched.

states.description: The Citrix ADC directory traversal / RCE exploit was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Traversal request blocked or returned no file content; version is likely patched.

states.description: The Exchange ProxyLogon/ProxyShell exploit chain was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Chain failed at the SSRF/authentication-bypass stage; version is likely patched.

states.description: No JNDI injection callback was observed across the probed input points.

detection_signals.description: No OOB callback across all probed input points; Log4j is not in use, is patched, or the vulnerable code path is unreachable.

states.description: Spring4Shell RCE confirmed exploitable via class-loader data binding.

detection_signals.description: A crafted parameter-binding payload that overwrites the Tomcat AccessLogValve pattern results in a subsequently accessible web shell.
examples: a JSP file appears at a predictable path and executes commands passed via a request parameter

states.description: Confluence OGNL injection RCE confirmed exploitable.

detection_signals.description: An OGNL expression injected via a crafted URL path is evaluated server-side.
examples: response reflects the evaluated result of an injected OGNL arithmetic expression, or an OOB callback fires

states.description: GitLab ExifTool RCE confirmed exploitable via crafted image upload.

detection_signals.description: An out-of-band callback fires when a crafted image file (malicious DjVu/exiftool metadata) is uploaded as an avatar/attachment.
examples: interactsh logs a hit shortly after the crafted image is uploaded and processed

states.description: Laravel Ignition debug-mode RCE confirmed exploitable.

detection_signals.description: A crafted request abusing Ignition's file_get_contents/file_put_contents debug functionality writes and executes a malicious file.
examples: a written file is subsequently retrievable and executes injected PHP code

states.description: Apache Struts Jakarta Multipart parser RCE confirmed exploitable.

detection_signals.description: An OGNL payload in the Content-Type header of a multipart upload request is evaluated during exception handling.
examples: response includes the output of an injected OS command, or an OOB callback fires

states.description: Citrix ADC/Gateway directory traversal to RCE confirmed exploitable.

detection_signals.description: A crafted path-traversal request writes a malicious Perl/template file that is then triggered for execution.
examples: a subsequently requested crafted path returns the output of an injected command

states.description: Microsoft Exchange Server RCE confirmed exploitable via the ProxyLogon/ProxyShell-family SSRF + authentication-bypass + arbitrary-file-write chain. Modeled here as a single consolidated exploit step; the real chain involves multiple intermediate CVEs (SSRF to bypass auth, then arbitrary file write to drop a web shell).

detection_signals.description: A web shell dropped via the chain is reachable and executes commands.
examples: a .aspx web shell at a predictable OWA-relative path returns command output

states.description: Log4Shell (Log4j2 JNDI injection) RCE confirmed exploitable.

detection_signals.description: An out-of-band LDAP/DNS callback fires after a JNDI lookup payload is submitted in any logged input, and a subsequent weaponized callback achieves class loading.
examples: interactsh/Collaborator logs an LDAP lookup correlated to the injected ${jndi:ldap://...} payload

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Windows host with SMBv1 enabled and reachable.

detection_signals.description: SMB version scan reports SMBv1 support enabled.
examples: nmap --script smb-protocols reports SMBv1 enabled

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Windows Active Directory Domain Controller (Netlogon RPC reachable).

detection_signals.description: Netlogon RPC endpoint (MS-NRPC) responds and host advertises domain controller SRV records.
examples: nmap detects port 135/445 with a Domain Controller service banner

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Windows host with the Print Spooler service exposed.

detection_signals.description: RPC endpoint mapper lists the spoolsv/MS-RPRN interface as reachable.
examples: rpcdump.py against the target lists the Print System Remote Protocol interface

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Progress MOVEit Transfer instance.

detection_signals.description: MOVEit-branded login portal or /human.aspx endpoint reachable.
examples: /human.aspx or the MOVEit login page is served at the default path

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as a Cisco IOS XE device with the web UI feature enabled.

detection_signals.description: Cisco IOS XE web UI login portal reachable over HTTPS on the management interface.
examples: HTTPS response on the device returns the Cisco IOS XE web UI login page

states.description: Target is fingerprinted as an Ivanti Connect Secure / Policy Secure VPN gateway.

detection_signals.description: Ivanti-branded VPN login portal reachable at the default path.
examples: /dana-na/ path serves the Ivanti Connect Secure login page

states.description: Zerologon exploitation was not successful against this domain controller.

detection_signals.description: Netlogon secure channel reset was rejected; target is patched (CVE-2020-1472 fix enforces secure RPC).

states.description: EternalBlue exploitation was not successful against this host.

detection_signals.description: SMBv1 exploit attempt failed; host is patched or SMBv1 is disabled.

states.description: PrintNightmare exploitation was not successful against this host.

detection_signals.description: Spooler RPC call was rejected; host is patched or Print Spooler service is disabled.

states.description: Follina exploitation was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Malicious document did not trigger MSDT execution; target is patched or MSDT protocol handler is disabled.

states.description: The MOVEit SQL injection exploit was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Payload rejected -- version is patched.

states.description: The Citrix Bleed session token leak was not reproducible against this target.

detection_signals.description: Crafted request did not leak memory content; version is likely patched.

states.description: The Cisco IOS XE web UI RCE exploit was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Payload rejected -- version is patched or web UI feature is disabled.

states.description: The Ivanti Connect Secure auth-bypass/command-injection chain was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Chain failed at the auth-bypass stage; version is patched or mitigation applied.

states.description: The GitLab password-reset account-takeover was not successful against this target.

detection_signals.description: Secondary unverified email was not honored for password reset; version is patched.

states.description: Zerologon (Netlogon privilege escalation) confirmed exploitable, yielding domain controller machine account takeover.

detection_signals.description: Repeated zero-value authentication attempts against Netlogon succeed, and the DC machine account password can be reset.
examples: public Zerologon PoC script reports successful authentication bypass

states.description: EternalBlue (SMBv1 remote code execution) confirmed exploitable, yielding SYSTEM-level code execution.

detection_signals.description: SMBv1 exploit successfully triggers a kernel payload and returns a SYSTEM-level callback.
examples: Metasploit's eternalblue module reports a successful session

states.description: PrintNightmare (Print Spooler remote code execution) confirmed exploitable, yielding SYSTEM-level code execution.

detection_signals.description: Malicious driver installation via RpcAddPrinterDriverEx succeeds and executes with SYSTEM privileges.
examples: public PrintNightmare PoC reports a SYSTEM-level callback

states.description: Follina (MSDT remote code execution via Office) confirmed exploitable against a victim opening the crafted document.

detection_signals.description: Opening the crafted document triggers MSDT and executes the embedded command as the victim user.
examples: OOB callback received when the victim opens the malicious document

states.description: MOVEit Transfer SQL injection confirmed exploitable, chained to remote code execution via a web shell.

detection_signals.description: Injected SQL payload against the MOVEit endpoint returns evidence of query execution, and a dropped web shell is reachable.
examples: a .aspx web shell dropped via the injection returns command output

states.description: Citrix Bleed (NetScaler session token leak) confirmed exploitable.

detection_signals.description: Crafted request triggers an out-of-bounds memory read that includes a valid session token in the response.
examples: response body contains a session cookie value not belonging to the requester

states.description: Cisco IOS XE web UI RCE confirmed exploitable, yielding a privileged implant/account on the device.

detection_signals.description: Crafted request against the web UI creates a new privilege-15 local user or implant.
examples: an unauthorized local user with privilege level 15 appears in the device configuration

states.description: Ivanti Connect Secure auth-bypass chained with command injection confirmed exploitable.

detection_signals.description: Auth-bypassed request to the vulnerable web component executes an injected command.
examples: response or OOB callback confirms command execution despite no valid session

states.description: GitLab password-reset account-takeover confirmed exploitable via an attacker-added unverified secondary email.

detection_signals.description: Password reset email is sent to the attacker-added secondary address for an arbitrary target account.
examples: password reset link intended for the victim account is received at the attacker-controlled address
